brief: Credit evaluation memorandum for an equipment term loan application submitted by Granite Peak Logistics LLC, drafted from financial statements and underwriting ratios.

# Commercial Credit Memorandum
Granite Peak Logistics LLC - Term Loan Request

## Facility Summary
| Parameter | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Applicant | Granite Peak Logistics LLC |
| Loan Request | $850,000 |
| Purpose | Fleet expansion (5 Class 8 dry-van tractors) |
| Term / Amortization | 60 months / 60 months |
| Proposed Rate | SOFR + 2.85% (floor 6.50%) |
| Collateral | 5 2026 Freightliner Cascadia units |
| Appraised Value | $1,050,000 ($210,000/unit) |
| Primary Guarantor | Raymond Banerjee (65% owner, FICO 748) |
| Secondary Guarantor | Sunita Osei (35% owner, FICO 732) |

## Financial Analysis
Granite Peak Logistics reported 2025 revenues of $4,820,000 and operating income of $412,000. Depreciation and amortization totaled $168,000, yielding EBITDA of $580,000. Existing annual debt service is $184,000 across two equipment lines.

| Metric | FY 2024 | FY 2025 | Target |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Total Revenue | $4,150,000 | $4,820,000 | N/A |
| EBITDA | $490,000 | $580,000 | N/A |
| Existing Debt Service | $184,000 | $184,000 | N/A |
| Proposed New Debt Service | - | $198,000 | N/A |
| Total Combined Debt Service | $184,000 | $382,000 | N/A |
| DSCR (Combined) | 2.66x | 1.52x | >= 1.25x |
| Funded Debt / EBITDA | 2.10x | 2.45x | <= 3.25x |

## Underwriting Strengths and Risks
- Historical cash flow supports total proposed debt service with a 2025 DSCR of 1.52x, exceeding policy minimums.
- Guarantors Raymond Banerjee and Sunita Osei demonstrate outside net worth of $1.45M and liquid reserves of $340,000.
- Loan-to-value based on equipment appraisal sits comfortably at 65.0%, providing adequate equity buffer.
- Borrower operates in a cyclical freight environment with rising diesel fuel costs.

## Recommendation
Underwriting recommends approval of the $850,000 facility subject to full joint and several personal guarantees from Raymond Banerjee and Sunita Osei, first-lien UCC-1 filing on titled vehicles, hazard insurance with the bank named as loss payee, and annual submission of CPA-reviewed corporate statements.

errors.explanation: The proposed loan is $850,000 against collateral appraised at $1,050,000, which yields a loan-to-value (LTV) of 81.0% ($850,000 / $1,050,000), not 65.0%.
errors.fix: Loan-to-value based on equipment appraisal sits comfortably at 81.0%, providing adequate equity buffer.

errors.quote: annual submission of CPA-reviewed corporate statements.
errors.explanation: For commercial credits with individual guarantors, mandatory financial reporting covenants must include the personal financial statements and tax returns of the guarantors alongside corporate statements.
errors.fix: annual submission of CPA-reviewed corporate statements and personal financial statements with tax returns for all guarantors.
